versionNotes: - **New Feature:** diagnostics page ("Diagnose & Protokoll"): environment overview, on-demand connection tests to NCBI (DNS, TCP per address, HTTPS via WordPress and via cURL forced to IPv4 / IPv6 with verbose log, comparison targets, automatic assessment), test mail, and a log of the latest 50 refresh attempts. Optional setting "Nur IPv4" as workaround for servers with a broken IPv6 route. Error messages now include the failing chunk and the elapsed time.
